$comment: npm install scripts (SEC-SC-08; scripts/supply_chain.py check, rule NODE-SCRIPTS). Every package a committed package-lock.json marks hasInstallScript is listed under its lock with what an image build or a CI job does with its script: `skip` (npm ci --ignore-scripts, with why that is safe) or `rebuild` (an `npm rebuild NAME` after the script-free install, the only scripts an image runs). Every `npm ci` in a Dockerfile or a CI workflow (.github/workflows, C644-FU-2) carries --ignore-scripts unless it is in `scriptedInstalls`, each with the reason and the follow-up that removes it. C6.44: no architecture runs a lock's scripts by default; a script runs only by name.
